claims.claim: Very clean double plate Red Dead Redemption II
claims.evidence: Case shown confirms title/platform, but disc cleanliness or plate count (single vs double disc) cannot be seen from the case photo alone.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo of the open case or disc surface was taken; case exterior alone cannot show if it was opened.
This claim describes a hardware device (console/controller), not a disc game case; nothing in the report shows ports or heat-related components for this item.
No controllers ('pads') are visible in the photo; only the game case was shown.
No receipt image was captured by the witness.

risks.risk: Disc may be scratched, unreadable, or missing entirely (empty case)
risks.proof: Photo of the open case showing the disc(s) resting in the tray, plus a close-up of the disc surface
risks.if_unproven: price as disc condition unknown / possibly non-functional

risks.risk: Mismatch between seller's hardware-related claims (overheating, ports, pads) and the actual item (a disc-only game case) suggests generic or copy-pasted listing text, or wrong/misleading description
risks.proof: Seller must clarify what 'pads' and 'ports' refer to for a disc game, or show the actual bundled items, console, or controllers claimed
risks.if_unproven: price as disc-only item, ignore unverified add-ons, treat description mismatch as a trust flag

risks.risk: Case may not include original artwork insert, manual, or DLC codes
risks.proof: Photo of the case interior with insert/manual visible

risks.risk: Region coding unknown, may not match buyer's console region expectations
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the region code area on the case or disc
risks.if_unproven: price as unconfirmed region, assume standard PAL/UK import per receipt claim but unverified

risks.risk: Receipt claim unverifiable, could be fabricated or for a different item
risks.proof: Clear photo of the actual UK receipt matching this item/date
risks.if_unproven: price as no proof of purchase, ignore receipt claim

proof_requests: Open-case photo showing the disc(s) in the tray
Close-up of the disc surface for scratch/wear check
Photo of case interior showing any insert/manual
Photo of the region code on case or disc
Clear photo of the UK receipt matching this item
Clarification and photo of the 'pads' and any hardware claimed (ports/overheating) since these do not match a disc-only item
response.reason: The seller's claims about overheating, ports, and pads describe hardware/console features that have no bearing on a disc-only game case, indicating likely copy-pasted or mismatched listing text, a red flag for scam or misrepresentation.
